O projeto simula um portal interno de apolices e sinistros com backend Spring Boot, persistencia JPA e frontends modernos consumindo APIs REST.**」**。**本次实测**：**⭐ 创建 **2026-09-15****、**末次**活动 **2026-09-15****（**窗口内）**、**★0****、**接口**许可**字段**为**空**而 **`LICENSE`** 文件**逐字 **MIT**（**逐字**：**Copyright (c) 2026 Carlos Paiva）**；**⭐ 顶层**目录**逐字 **12** 项**（**含 **`backend`／**`frontend-react`／**`frontend-angular-mfe`／**`docs`／**`scripts`／**`LICENSE`／**`README.md`／**`SECURITY.md`）**；**⭐ 技术**栈**逐字**为 **Java 11／**Spring Boot 2.7／**Spring Data JPA／**Hibernate／**React 18＋**TypeScript＋**Vite＋**Zustand／**Angular 17（**微前端）**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**非 **GitHub** 的**代码**托管面**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① ⚠️⭐ 它**暴**露**了**一**类**徽章**陷阱**——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README** 顶**部**的 **CI** 与 **CodeQL** 徽章**都**指**向 **`github.com/cafpaiva/securepolicy-platform/actions/...`****，**而**该 **GitHub** 仓库**经 **API** 查询**逐字**返回 **`Not Found`****；**⭐ 本词条**据此**指出**：**⭐ 即**徽章**是**图**片**链接**，**它**只**证明**写**徽章**时**那**个 **URL** 被**认为**存**在**，**不**证明**它**现在**存**在**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**看**项目**质量**时**，**把**徽章**当**线索**而**非**证据**，**并**且**要**点**开**验**证**（**⭐ 与**第 **380** 轮**记下的**「**文档**站**／**CI** 徽章**可**读**出**信息」**并不**矛盾**：**徽章**可**提示**作者**意图**，**但**存**活**要**另**测）**；**② **它**是**本站**少**见**的**葡**语**保险**项目**，**且**领域**词**很**直**接**（**`apolices` = **保单**、**`sinistros` = **理赔）**——**⭐ 即**巴西**市场的**系统**语**境**；**③ **它**把**开**发**环境**与**生产**环境**分**开**处**理**（**逐字**：**H2 em memoria para desenvolvimento local／**Perfis preparados para MySQL e Oracle**）**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**「**本地**用**内存**库**、**线上**用**真**库」**是**一**个**可**照**抄**的**最小**配置**；**④ **它**的 **`docs/`** 逐字**含 **`ROADMAP`／**`SPRINTS`／**`BACKLOG`／**GitFlow** 与**工程**规范**——**⭐ 即**把**「**怎么**做**这个**项目」**当**成**交付**物**之一**（**⭐ 与**第 **380** 轮**记下的**「**复现**要**写清**起点**与**边界」**同**向）**。**⚠️ 本次**未克隆**、**未**构建**、**未跑**其**前后**端**。
e.body:
**securepolicy-platform**（GitLab `paiva.charles/securepolicy-platform`）**是一个**用**葡**语**写**的**保单**与**理赔**门户**演示**项目****——**逐字自述（葡语）**为**「**Aplicacao demonstrativa desenvolvida Java / React. O projeto simula um portal interno de apolices e sinistros com backend Spring Boot, persistencia JPA e frontends modernos consumindo APIs REST.**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**非 **GitHub** 的**代码**托管面**」**。
**可核实信息（均 2026-09-23 GitLab 与 GitHub 接口实测）**：
**⭐⭐⭐ ① ⚠️⭐ 它**暴露**了**一**类**徽章**陷阱**（**徽章**指**向**不**存在**的**镜像）****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README** 顶**部**两**个**徽章**逐字**指向 **`https://github.com/cafpaiva/securepolicy-platform/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg`** 与 **`https://github.com/cafpaiva/securepolicy-platform/actions/workflows/codeql.yml/badge.svg`****，**而 **`https://api.github.com/repos/cafpaiva/securepolicy-platform`** 逐字**返回 **`Not Found`****；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**对 **RIAA** 最有用**：**⭐ 即**徽章**是**一**张**外**链**图**片**，**渲染**成**功**只**说明**写**徽章**的**那**一刻**作者**以为**该 **URL** 存在**，**不**说明**它**今天**存在**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**评**估**一个**项目**时**，**把**徽章**当**线索**（**它**透**露**作者**重**视** CI** 与**代码**扫描）**，**但**「**有** CI」**这**个**事实**要**另**测**；**⭐ 本词条**如实**指出**：**⭐ 这**与**第 **380** 轮**记下的**「**从**徽章**读**出**测试**、**文档**与**发布**状态」**并**不**矛盾**——**徽章**可用**于**推**断**作者**意图**，**存**活**须**单**独**验**证**。
**⭐⭐ ② 它**是**本站**少**见**的**葡**语**保险**项目**，**领域**词**直**接****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README** 逐字**含 **`portal interno de apolices e sinistros`**（**保单**与**理赔**的**内部**门户）**，**仓库**描述**逐字**为**「**Full stack insurance platform with Java, Spring Boot, React, Angular MFE, Clean Architecture and automated quality gates.**」**；**⭐ 本词条**据此**指出**：**⭐ 即**同一**领域**在**不**同**语言**市场**里**的**术语**与**结**构**差**异**（**如 **`apolice`／**`sinistro`）**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**做**跨**市场**研究**或**求职**时**，**掌**握**当地**领域**词**能**直**接**扩大**可**检索**范围**（**⭐ 与**第 **374／375** 轮**记下的**「**非**英语**检索**面」**同**向）**。
**⭐⭐ ③ 它**把**开发**环境**与**生产**环境**分**开**处**理****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README** 逐字**列**出 **`H2 em memoria para desenvolvimento local`**（**本地**开发**用**内存 **H2）** 与 **`Perfis preparados para MySQL e Oracle`**（**已**准备 **MySQL** 与 **Oracle** 的 **profile）**；**⭐ 本词条认为**：**⭐ 即**「**本地**零**依赖**启动**＋**线上**切**真**库」**是**让**别人**（**与**面试**官）**能**在**五**分钟**内**跑**起来**的**关键**配置**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**交**课程**项目**时**，**把**默**认**配置**设**为**可**零**依赖**运行**，**会**显著**提高**被**真**正**打开**的**概**率**。
**⭐⭐ ④ 它**把 **`docs/`** 里**的**规划**与**规范**当**成**交付**物**之一****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README** 逐字**链**出 **`docs/ROADMAP.md`／**`docs/SPRINTS.md`／**`docs/BACKLOG.md`** 与 **GitFlow** 等**文档**，**并**逐字**给出**目录**说明**（**`backend/`** 为 **Spring Boot** 保险 **API**、**`frontend-react/`** 为 **React＋**Zustand** 主**看板**、**`frontend-angular-mfe/`** 为**可**选**的 **Angular** 微前端**、**`docs/`** 为**路线**图**与**工程**标准）**；**⭐ 本词条**据此**指出**：**⭐ 即**「**怎么**做**这个**项目」**（**排期**、**分支**策略**、**工程**约定）**本**身**就是**可**评**价**的**产出**（**⭐ 与**第 **380** 轮**记下的**「**复现**包**要**写清**起点**、**边界**与**排除**项」**同**属**流程**透**明**一**类）**。
**⭐⭐ ⑤ 许可**与**元数据****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**GitLab** 项目**接口**的 **`license`** 字段**为**空**，**而**仓库**内 **`LICENSE`** 文件**逐字**起**首**为 **`MIT License`** 与 **`Copyright (c) 2026 Carlos Paiva`****；**⭐ 本词条**如实**指出**：**⭐ 即**这**一**条**与**本**轮 **Aegis** 那**条**同**现**了**「**接口**字段**空**、**仓库**有**许可**文件」**的**情形**（**⭐ 故**本**词条**把**「**读**文件**而**非**读**字段」**记**为**本**轮**的**一**条**可**复用**判**据）**。
**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[susep-open-insurance]] 覆盖**巴西**开放**保险**监管**语境**、**[[insurancepro-crm]] 覆盖**保险 **CRM**、**[[corredor-broker-platform]] 覆盖**经纪**平台**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**以**葡**语**实**现**的**保单**与**理赔**内部**门户**演示**项目**」这一**形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。
**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **徽章**是**线索**不**是**证据**；**② **掌**握**当地**领域**词**扩大**检索**面**；**③ **本地**零**依赖**＋**线上**切**真**库**；**④ **把**规划**与**规范**当**交付**物**；**⑤ **判**许可**读**仓库**文件**。
**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有克隆**其**仓库**、**未**构建**或**运行**其 **Spring Boot** 后端**与**两**个**前端**、**未**跑**其**任何**测试**或 **CI**，**故**不**主张**其**可**运行**性**、**功能**完整性**或**代码**质量**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**GitLab** 项目**接口**、**仓库**顶层**目录**接口**、**`README.md`**、**`LICENSE`** 文件**与 **GitHub** 仓库**接口**（**用**于**验证**徽章**指向**的**镜像**是否**存在）**，**未读**其**源码**、**`docs/`** 内容**或**测试**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**徽章**指向**的 **GitHub** 仓库**是否**曾**存在**或**现**为**私有**（**⭐ 本次**只**测**得 **API** 返回 **Not Found）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其 **H2／**MySQL／**Oracle** 三**套**配**置**是否**都**可**用**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**是否**有**测试**用例**（**徽章**存在**不**代表**测试**存在）**。**⑥ ⚠️ **★0** 与**创建**／**末次**活动**同日（**2026-09-15）**为 **2026-09-23** 快照**。**⑦ ⚠️ 窗口**状况**：**末次**活动 **2026-09-15** 落在**本轮**窗口**之内**（**基准日 **2026-09-23）**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-23 所见**；**⚠️ 其**为**演示**项目**，**⚠️ 不**构成**任何**核保**、**理赔**或**合规**意见**。

e.summary_en: This is a policy and claims portal demonstration project written in Portuguese, describing itself as a demonstration application in Java and React that simulates an internal policy and claims portal with a Spring Boot backend, JPA persistence, and modern front ends consuming REST APIs. **Measured this round**: created and last active on the same day in mid-September inside the window, with no stars, an empty licence field in the hosting interface while the licence file in the repository is MIT with a copyright line, twelve top-level entries including separate back end, React front end, Angular micro-front-end, documentation, scripts, and a security policy, and a stated stack of an older Java release with a matching Spring Boot version, a recent React version with TypeScript, Vite, and a state library, and a recent Angular version used as a micro-front-end. **This round theme is the non-GitHub code hosting surface.** **Four things are worth reading: it exposes a badge trap, since the continuous integration and code scanning badges at the top of the readme both point at a mirror repository whose API query returns not found, and a badge is an image link that only proves the URL was believed to exist when the badge was written rather than that it exists now, so badges should be treated as clues and verified by clicking through, which does not contradict the earlier note that badges can be read for signals, because badges indicate author intent while liveness has to be tested separately; it is an unusually Portuguese-language insurance project with direct domain vocabulary for policies and claims, situating it in one national market context; it separates development and production environments by using an in-memory database locally with profiles prepared for two server databases, which is a minimum configuration worth copying; and its documentation directory holds planning artefacts including a roadmap, sprint plan, backlog, and branching convention, so how the project was built is itself part of the delivery, in the same spirit as the earlier note that a replication package should state its starting point and boundary.** **Nothing was cloned, built, or run this round.**

e.body_en:
This is a policy and claims portal demonstration project written in Portuguese. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the non-GitHub code hosting surface.**
**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-23 from the hosting and mirror interfaces**:
**First, it exposes a badge trap in which badges point at a mirror that does not exist.** Two badges at the top of the readme point at workflow badge URLs under a mirror repository on another platform, while an API query for that repository returns not found. **A badge is an image link, so rendering successfully only shows that the author believed the URL existed when the badge was written, not that it exists now, which means badges are clues rather than evidence: they reveal that the author cared about continuous integration and code scanning, while the claim that integration exists still needs its own test. This does not contradict the earlier note about reading signals from badges, because badges indicate intent while liveness must be verified separately.**
**Second, it is an unusually Portuguese-language insurance project with direct domain vocabulary**, describing an internal portal for policies and claims, and its repository description calls it a full stack insurance platform with automated quality gates. **The same domain carries different terms and structures in different language markets, so knowing local domain vocabulary directly widens what can be found when doing cross-market research or a job search, in the same direction as the earlier notes on non-English search surfaces.**
**Third, it separates development and production environments.** The readme states that an in-memory database is used for local development and that profiles are prepared for two server databases. **Zero-dependency local startup with a switch to a real database online is the key configuration for letting someone else, or an interviewer, run the project within minutes, and defaulting coursework to a zero-dependency configuration markedly raises the chance it is actually opened.**
**Fourth, it treats planning and conventions as part of the delivery.** The readme links a roadmap, a sprint plan, a backlog, and a branching convention, and explains a directory layout in which the back end holds a Spring Boot insurance API, one front end holds a React and Zustand dashboard, a second front end holds an optional Angular micro-front-end, and the documentation directory holds the roadmap and engineering standards. **How the project was made, including scheduling, branching, and conventions, is therefore itself an assessable output, in the same family as the earlier requirement that a replication package state its starting point, boundary, and exclusions.**
**Fifth, licence and metadata.** The hosting interface reports an empty licence field while the licence file in the repository opens with an MIT licence and a copyright line. **This reproduces the same pattern seen in the other platform entry this round, so reading repository files rather than interface fields is recorded as a reusable criterion of this round.**
**Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover the national open insurance regulatory context, an insurance customer relationship tool, and a broker platform, **while this entry supplies the form of a Portuguese-language demonstration project implementing an internal policy and claims portal. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**
**For RIAA**: **five practices transfer: treat badges as clues rather than evidence; learn local domain vocabulary to widen searching; provide zero-dependency local startup with real databases behind profiles; treat planning and conventions as deliverables; and read licences from repository files.**
**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the repository was not cloned, neither the back end nor either front end was built or run, and no test or integration pipeline was executed**, so no claim is made about runnability, feature completeness, or code quality. **Second, only the hosting interface, the top-level tree interface, the readme, the licence file, and the mirror repository interface, the last used to test whether the badge target exists, were read**, not the source, the documentation directory contents, or tests. **Third, whether the mirror repository ever existed or is now private was not verified**, this entry only measuring that an API query returns not found. **Fourth, whether all three database configurations are usable was not verified. Fifth, whether test cases exist was not verified**, a badge being no proof of tests. **Sixth, the star count and the creation and last activity dates are a snapshot from the twenty-third of September. Seventh, the last activity falls inside this round window against that baseline. Eighth, this entry records what was visible on that date and states plainly that the project is a demonstration and constitutes no underwriting, claims, or compliance opinion.**
